name: jab-sw1-gloves
description: Street boxing gloves around JAB Boxing Club SW1. Pin id is the STAR objective title and the NFT trailPinId. Coords are public-street approximations, not indoor.

properties.title: Club door mitt
properties.narrationText: The first mitt sits on the pavement outside the club door. Check in to mint it into your OASIS Solana wallet.
properties.directionHint: Unit 5, Colonnade Walk, 151 Buckingham Palace Road. Stay on the public colonnade.

properties.title: Colonnade Walk mitt
properties.narrationText: Along the colonnade, a second glove. Same hunt, same wallet.
properties.directionHint: Public walkway west of the club entrance.

properties.title: Victoria station mitt
properties.narrationText: The rail hop from Finsbury lands here. The glove is on the public station approach, not the platforms.
properties.directionHint: Victoria station street approach, Buckingham Palace Road side.

properties.title: Grosvenor Gardens mitt
properties.narrationText: North of the club, the square holds the fourth mitt.
properties.directionHint: Public paths in Grosvenor Gardens. Stay off private hotel forecourts.

properties.title: Palace Road mitt
properties.narrationText: A linear street mitt on Buckingham Palace Road between the club and the station.

properties.title: Eccleston mitt
properties.narrationText: The outer mitt, Belgravia edge. Collect this and the set is complete.
properties.directionHint: Public pavement around Eccleston Place / Eccleston Yards approach.
